summary: This bill amends the Energy Policy Act of 2005 to require the Secretary of Energy to establish at least two precommercial bioindustrial technology maturation facilities by September 30, 2030, to conduct research, development, demonstration, and commercial application for biotechnology-based products, operating as user facilities for governmental and nongovernmental entities.

scores.thoughts: The bill explicitly authorizes $225,500,000 in appropriations for fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to establish and operate bioindustrial technology maturation facilities. This directly increases government spending.

The bill aims to support the development and commercial application of biotechnology products, including those derived from biomass and waste streams, to increase energy resiliency. This promotes technologies that could reduce reliance on fossil fuels and utilize waste, thus having a positive impact on environmental protection.
